topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I was just browsing, not really looking for anything in particular. Flipping through some old books, glancing at the knick-knacks, when something caught my eye. There, on the ground, half-hidden behind a stack of vinyl records, was a teddy bear. Not just any teddy bear, but one with a familiar patch over one eye and a red bow tie. My heart skipped a beat. This was my bear, the one I used to whisper secrets to, the one I couldn’t sleep without as a kid. The fabric looked a bit worn, a little faded, but it was undeniably him. I hadn’t seen him in years, thought he was long gone. Picking him up felt like reconnecting with a piece of my childhood. It’s funny how things from the past can just show up when you least expect it.
